name: Paris Breath 1g Live Resin Disposable
description:
Breeder: Gage Green Genetics 

Lineage: Paris OG x Grateful Breath 

Terpenes: Myrcene, Limonene, Caryophyllene 

Aroma: Sweet, Earthy, Floral 

Effects: Sleepy, Happy, Relaxed 

Step into the night with Paris Breath, the ultimate strain for an adventurous evening. The zesty citrus and earthy pine awaken your senses, while a hint of floral sweetness invites you to kick back and enjoy the ride. As the night unfolds, its relaxing effects kick in, leaving you feeling blissfully tingly and ready to unwind in a state of serene euphoria. Whether you're laughing with friends or enjoying a solo moment of peace, Paris Breath sets the perfect vibe for a fun, relaxed night full of good times and even better memories.
